BiblicalUsage: This noun for a gathering or collection occurs once, in Isaiah 24:22: 'they shall be gathered together, as prisoners are gathered in the pit, and shall be shut up in the prison, and after many days shall they be visited.' It is the herding of the proud kings and powers into a pit, like captives rounded up after a battle.
TheologicalSignificance: One verse gathers the kings of the earth like prisoners into a pit — and then says ‘after many days shall they be visited’ — and I believe the gathering is God’s judgment and the visit is His reckoning.
